{{Quote|You have the book. The hunt awaits. Now get to work!|Cradossk|<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BountyHuntersGuildHandbook-TheBountyHunterCode.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The title page of an annotated copy of the Updated Imperial Edition of the ''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook'']]
The '''''Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook''''' was a continually updated handbook written for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] wishing to join the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] edition was released whilst [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] was head of the guild. Several chapters were included from previous editions, and some were included unedited, such as that written by [[Gleed Ontondon]].<ref name="TBHC" />

[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] gave [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] a copy that was previously owned by both [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. In addition to annotations by all four bounty hunters, Fett combined his handbook with a manifesto on [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], and called it ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]''.<ref name="TBHC" />
